clues.kinetics: A high-fat meal raises exposure, and for the tablet Cmax rises 79%. It is 99.5-99.75% bound to plasma proteins and principally metabolized by cytochrome P450.
clues.substance: The active moiety has a molecular weight of 315.67. It is a crystalline powder that is practically insoluble in water.
clues.product: Approved under an NDA in 50 mg and 200 mg capsules and 600 mg tablets, dosed once daily.
clues.safety: No boxed warning; contraindicated with hypersensitivity to any component and with elbasvir/grazoprevir. Impaired concentration and abnormal dreams are common.
clues.indication: Treatment of HIV-1 infection in combination with other antiretrovirals, in adults and in children weighing at least 3.5 kg.
clues.mechanism: A non-nucleoside reverse transcriptase inhibitor of HIV-1.

tell: It induces its own metabolism: half-life is 52 to 76 hours after single doses but 40 to 55 hours after multiple doses.
